title: cereus guatemalensis
intro: Cereus guatemalensis, commonly known as the Guatemalan columnar cactus, is a species of cactus in the genus Cereus. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Cereus guatemalensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
